title: The specified etale exceptional precomposition comparison
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring of universe u+1, and use ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-A module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let u:U→X be a separated finite-type etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and f:X→S a morphism, with U,X,S Noetherian and f and f∘u compactifiable [def-asd-compactifiable]. Given a graph-normalized compact-support datum N [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization], define E_(u,f):Rf! followed by u* ≅ R(f∘u)! by conjugating the specified etale left comparison [def-sp-etale-adjoint-chart-comparison] under the compact-support exceptional adjunctions [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint] and the derived sum/evaluation adjunction. The result is tensorMateEtalePrecompLocalityIso, in the direction Rf! ⋙ u* → R(f∘u)!, with its actual counit normalization; it is not the tensor-precomposition compatibility theorem.

lean.statement:
def tensorMateEtalePrecompLocalityIso
    (A : Type (v + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : EtaleCompactSupportNormalization A)
    {U X S : Scheme.{v}} (u : U ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Etale u] [IsSeparated u] [LocallyOfFiniteType u] [QuasiCompact u]
    [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification (u ≫ f)] :
    R(f)^![ModuleCat A] ⋙ (u)^*[ModuleCat A].mapDerivedCategory ≅
      R(u ≫ f)^![ModuleCat A]
